description: Launch an RL-environment feedback project (Step 11 RLENV_FEEDBACK): human experts rate, step-label, pairwise-compare, or demonstrate episodes from your RL environment through the OpenTrain editor; rewards land on the quality ledger and export as verifiers/DPO/PRM/SFT JSONL. Requires rlenv:write scope + the public_api_rlenv rollout.

environmentId.description: Environment connection id (create one in the app).

episodes.description: Inline first batch (verifiers rollouts, OpenEnv episodes, or generic chat).

gradingMode.description: RATE = rubric scores + verdict; STEP_LABELS = per-step PRM labels; PAIRWISE = A/B preference (DPO); DEMONSTRATION = experts drive the env live (SFT).

rubric.description: Rubric spec {criteria: [{key, label, kind: HUMAN|JUDGE|EXACT|STATE_DIFF|PARSER, weight, config?}]}.

name: opentrain_rlenv_launch
